svg.text: DecisionTrace: how decisions come in, are kept safe, and are explained
Every lender sees only its own data. Each decision is a tamper-evident record; an AI model only ever helps where the lender and the customer allow it.
Sends decisions as an API call,
or a CSV / JSON file in any layout
Sign in with an access key
through a link from the lender
Web address, Cloud Storage file, or one
tokens and passwords are never stored
Connect your data (file or data source)
Caddy (HTTPS) and nginx pass /api to the service;
nobody adds credentials on the way
1 Sign-in, roles, one lender at a time
Staff keys and customer links; every request
is limited to its lender (row-level security)
File, API or allow-listed data source in; AI proposes columns;
a person approves; fixed rules do the import (retries safe)
3 The record: one hash chain per decision
never overwritten). Optional encryption per lender
repeat applicants, guessing, shifts in outcomes
Fingerprints sealed in batches; proofs anyone
can check; changes after sealing are reported
Built from the saved record by fixed steps.
An AI summary only if policy and customer allow
The service connects as a role that can
add rows but not change or delete them,
and sees one lender's rows at a time
Local master secret today (from Secret Manager).
A cloud or hardware key service is the next step
Folder copied to a locked bucket the database
admin can't rewrite; timestamp service is next
AI model (optional, Gemini; off in the demo)
Gets only the explanation's own facts,
the service fetches it, then the same checks apply
decisions go straight to the service: an API call or an uploaded file
Deployed demo: one Google Cloud VM (e2-medium) running Docker Compose
Synthetic data only. Only ports 80 and 443 are open; administrators connect through Identity-Aware Proxy.
Generated keys are copied to a root-only file on the VM; never in the code or the screens
Taken after the demo scenarios are loaded, so it can be restored
Anchor log and seal copies, sent on a timer by the VM's account, which can only create objects there

g.text: The flow, in order
Bring data in
A bank sends a decision, or uploads a
file in its own layout. The AI suggests
how the columns match; a person checks
and approves; nothing is saved before
that.
Save it as a record
Each decision and its evidence go into a
hash chain. If the lender turned on
protection, the evidence is encrypted
under a key for that decision.
Check it
Data checks find missing or unlikely
values and propose fixes as appended
corrections. Risk signals point at
patterns for a person to look at.
Seal it
New records are fingerprinted, sealed in
a signed batch and copied outside the
database. Later changes show up when
seals are checked.
Explain it
The explanation is built from the saved
record by fixed steps. An AI summary is
added only if the lender allows it and
the customer hasn't said no.
Show it
Customers see their own decision, what
was corrected, whether it is sealed and
their choices. Staff see signals and
tools. Erasing destroys the key; the
record still verifies.

Dashed box or arrow: optional, or planned but not built yet. Green: the tamper-evident record and its seals. Orange: AI help, only where allowed. Demonstration build: all people and decisions are fictional.
